messages:
Alex: Escalating a P1 from Support — MosaicRx onboarding blocked. Embedding/index ingest failing during initial content upload; customer cannot complete enablement. Ticket SUP-2219. Renewal ~28 days (enterprise trial). @Priya can CS take?
Priya: Got it. Please paste the exact error payload, sample file info, and whether they hit any quota or throttling. Also confirm if we offered a temp workaround.
Alex: Error snippet from support logs:
```
POST /api/v1/embeddings 422 {"error":"unprocessable_entity", "detail":"document_too_large_or_invalid_tokens"}
```
Customer uploaded a ~35MB PDF, retried twice, second attempt saw 503s from ingestion workers. They want to proceed with onboarding today.
Diego: I'll triage ingestion pipeline and worker metrics. Hypothesis: tokenizer/token explosion on large doc causing worker OOM -> 503. Checking queue depth and worker logs now. ETA ~30m.
Priya: Short-term options: (A) manual ingestion by Support/CS, (B) provide chunking guidance and re-run, or (C) temporarily bump resources for onboarding. We should prep a customer comm and loop in Sales for renewal risk. @Liam can you join?
Liam: I'm on it. Recommend offering one-time credit or temporary capacity bump plus a hands-on session to rebuild confidence. I'll coordinate with AM.
csbot: SUP-2219 created and escalated to cs-oncall. Severity: P1 (onboarding blocked).
Diego: Confirmed repeated tokenization failures and worker OOMs for large PDF. I provisioned a temporary ingest-worker with higher memory and drained the backlog. Commands run: `kubectl -n infra set resources deploy/ingest-worker --requests=cpu=500m,memory=2Gi` and then `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/ingest-worker`.
Alex: Support ran manual ingest via the admin console after Diego's fix. Customer confirms the import completed and they could continue onboarding steps.
Priya: Great. Actions: 1) CS to run a 1:1 onboarding session within 24h to re-run initial import and validate their flows (owner: Priya). 2) Docs: add large-document chunking guidance to onboarding playbook and quickstart (owner: Priya, deadline 48h). 3) Eng: add CI test for ingesting >10MB PDFs and an alert for tokenization OOMs (owner: Diego, deadline 72h). 4) Sales/AM: offer one-time trial credit and renewal outreach (owner: Liam).
Liam: I'll notify the AM and draft the renewal message. Priya, include mitigation and timeline language and I'll send.
Priya: Draft customer comms: "Hi MosaicRx team — were sorry for the interruption. We processed your documents manually and restored onboarding access. For sustained ingestion, we recommend splitting large PDFs into smaller chunks; well join a 1:1 with you to assist and confirm everything is working. Well follow up with a short incident summary and next steps."
Alex: Updated SUP-2219 with logs, remediation steps, and owners. Closing the immediate loop. Thanks all. :tada:
Priya: Please add a short postmortem in SUP-2219 and tag me when ready. I'll follow up on the onboarding call outcome and close the renewal risk loop.
